overview.text: She supports raising wages and expanding retirement benefits, and she wants to cut red tape to build affordable housing. She cites a district plan to build roughly 800 affordable units on unused land. She says she would strengthen Medi-Cal and expand the healthcare workforce. She says she will keep ICE out of schools, hospitals, churches and neighborhoods.
